lines.text: On the third day a wedding took place at Cana in Galilee, and Jesus' mother was there.
When the wine ran out, Jesus' mother told Him so, and then told the servants to do whatever He said.
Jesus told the servants to fill six stone jars with oil, then take some to the banquet master.
The master of the banquet tasted the wine and told the bridegroom he had saved the fine wine until now.
After the first sign, Jesus went down to Bethsaida with His mother, His brothers and His disciples.
